title: Incorporation of Silicon-Oxygen Tetrahedron into Novel High-Nuclearity Nanosized 3d-4f Heterometallic Clusters

synthesis.procedure: Gd2O3, nickel(II) acetate tetrahydrate, iminodiacetic acid, imidazole, and sodium metasilicate nonahydrate were stirred in distilled water and ethanol for 12 h at room temperature. The solution was adjusted to pH 4.5–5.0 with aqueous HCl, sealed in a 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave, and heated under autogenous pressure at 180 °C for 8 days.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature for stirring; 180 °C for hydrothermal reaction
synthesis.time: 12 h stirring; 8 days heating; 24 h drying
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave; autogenous pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After cooling to room temperature, blue rectangular crystals were filtered, washed with ethanol, and dried at room temperature for 24 h.

properties.summary: The susceptibility and magnetization data indicate weak antiferromagnetic interactions. The cluster exhibits a substantial low-temperature magnetocaloric effect.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete cluster comprises two pairs of bowl-shaped {Gd24Ni20} and butterfly-like silicate-containing fragments. The butterfly-like fragments bridge the bowls, and the core includes a 14-membered ring formed from six Si–O and eight Gd–O polyhedra.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the procedure for compound 1, substituting Eu2O3 for Gd2O3. Eu2O3, nickel(II) acetate tetrahydrate, iminodiacetic acid, imidazole, and sodium metasilicate nonahydrate were stirred in distilled water and ethanol for 12 h at room temperature. The solution was adjusted to pH 4.5–5.0 with aqueous HCl and heated in a sealed autoclave under autogenous pressure at 180 °C for 8 days.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature for stirring; 180 °C for hydrothermal reaction
synthesis.time: 12 h stirring; 8 days heating; 24 h drying, following the procedure for 1
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave; autogenous pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Blue rectangular crystals were obtained; the shared procedure specifies cooling, filtration, ethanol washing, and drying at room temperature.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The Eu analogue has a silicate-containing high-nuclearity core related to that of compound 1 but contains two fewer Ni ions; the article describes the resulting coordination-sphere difference as small.
